notes.title: Fixed error when running .exe on some machines.
notes.notes: I just updated the ride as some users were getting a could not find exe error.  Please post in the community page if you have any issues.  Enjoy and thanks for the feedback.

notes.title: Full Act 1 is now available
notes.notes: Hello Dark Ride fans, the full Act 1 of 3 is now available and includes 14.5 minutes of a very detailed ride experience.  Currently the 3rd highest rated VR app in Meta Quest App Lab store.  I hope you enjoy it as much as I have had making it and are looking forward to Act 2 and 3 which you will get for free if you own Act 1 or accessed the free demo.  Enjoy
